metas.name: Eyes
metas.description: Tina Sebastian, a police officer investigates disturbing cases involving women. As the investigation progresses, mental health professionals join forces with the police to understand the psychology of stalkers, identify warning signs and prevent situations from escalating.

metas.name: Brothers-in-Law
metas.description: Aliyans (Brothers-in-Law) is a hit Malayalam sitcom on Kaumudy TV, directed by Rajesh Thalachira. It premiered on February 24, 2020, as a sequel to Aliyan vs Aliyan (Brother-in-Law vs Brother-in-Law). Set in Thiruvananthapuram, the show follows Ratnamma and her family, centering on the love-hate dynamic between brothers-in-law Kanakan and Cleatus. Most episodes revolve around Cleatus landing in trouble thanks to his quirky ideas, with Kanakan often stepping in to save the day.

metas.name: Prince of Mollywood
metas.description: Firoz has one dream: become a Pan-Indian superstar. But everyone around him has other plans. His friends are experts at ruining things. Vappa Mammali turns producer hoping one flop will send him straight back to the family business. Umma is busy finding him a bride on matrimony sites. And then there's his girlfriend.

metas.name: Poacher
metas.description: A group of Indian Forest Service officers, NGO workers, police constables and good samaritans risk their lives trying to track down the biggest elephant ivory poachers in the history of India and bring them to justice.

metas.name: Manorathangal
metas.description: Eight legendary filmmakers collaborate with 9 superstars, breathing life into the timeless stories of author M.T. Vasudevan Nair. Based in Kerala, these stories explore the nuances of human nature.

metas.name: Patharamattu
metas.description: A mother seeks ideal matches for her three daughters. Two families: wealthy jeweler Ananthamoorthy's clan and modest Udayabhanu and Kanakadurga with their daughters.

metas.name: 1000 Babies
metas.description: Enter a cradle of mysteries where a man with a dark past manipulates multiple lives through a series of cryptic letters and deadly games.

metas.name: Nagendran’s Honeymoons
metas.description: A lazy man named Nagendran, who, with his friend Soman, hatches a plan to marry multiple women to earn money from dowry to escape his village and find a better life abroad.

metas.name: Kappi Squad
metas.description: Four emotionally unfinished young adults turn their insecurit ego and wounded pride into an unlikely café business. How will these four go for validation?

metas.name: Secret Stories: Roslin
metas.description: A 17-year-old girl is plagued by nightmares of a green-eyed stalker, pulling her into a spiral of fear and despair.

metas.name: Masterpeace
metas.description: When marital discord becomes everyone's business and parents get way too involved in the "peace talks," family drama can become family trauma.

metas.name: Pharma
metas.description: A young medical representative struggles against the pharma game, masters it and eventually fights against it.

metas.name: Love Under Construction
metas.description: Vinod is ready to build his dream house. But is he ready to face the hurdles in his path?

metas.name: Pavithram
metas.description: Forced marriage, a clash of tradition and faith, leads to a complex journey of transformation for a woman named Vedha. The series explores themes of resilience, redemption, and the power of love amidst societal pressures

metas.name: Perilloor Premier League
metas.description: Malavika, who comes to the village of Perilloor to find love with her boyfriend Sreekuttan, unexpectedly ends up becoming the village Panchayat President against her will. Later, her life goes upside down along with the problems stirred by the wayward people of Perilloor Panchayath.

metas.name: Jai Mahendran
metas.description: When Mahendran, a corrupt and manipulative deputy Thasildar, believes in getting things done through powerplay and influence within the system, becomes the victim of his own plans to sabotage an entire system in an attempt to safeguard his job and restore his reputation.

metas.name: Uppum Mulakum
metas.description: The sitcom drama revolves around the family of Balachandran, his wife Neelima, their four kids Vishnu, Lakshmi, Keshav, Shivani and Neelima's Brother Sreekuttan.

metas.name: Kalakkachi
metas.description: It revolves around the unique fish curry 'Kalakkachi'. The storyline takes an interesting turn when one of the hotels decides to ruin its competitor, by spoiling their unique dish 'Kalakkachi'. How the spoiled dish creates ruckus among the lives of four men forms the crux of the story.

metas.name: Tuition Veedu
metas.description: Tuition Class Based in a Rural Home, a Degree Student Named Amirtha, Teaches Her Neighbor's Children

metas.name: Mazha Thorum Munpe
metas.description: Abandoned as a child, Aleena grows up longing for love. Will life ever lead her back to her lost parents and the happiness she dreams of?
